context: Request: current count of the firm's patent-infringement cases actively in litigation, with a list. Rubric: 1013-00005 (Genome Dx v. Helios) and 1014-00004 (Optiwave v. Lumicore) as the two active cases, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Attempt 2: one script prints every matter's file count and full file list (about 545K chars). End label note: List matter folders; no later listing work.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path regex for request words and litigation-step words, grouped per matter. The review flags path-only matching and about 20 surfaced matters left unaccounted for.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out twice, then reruns in three range batches with per-matter counts; four high-count matters lead.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads complaints, status reports, closing and dismissal papers of five candidates; two guessed paths fail. The review flags dozens of unopened matters and that one counted matter's status rests on a report a year old.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of 15 candidate matters; the review flags unlisted sibling matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: table of file counts and file-name hits for all 95 scan-hit matters taken from the saved scan output. End label note: List matter folders; no later listing work.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two active cases with exclusions for settled, dismissed and non-litigation matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, a path check opens the response from the working folder, fails and is rerun, four citation edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: path searches and store-wide text scans surface the same handful of litigation matters; reads of complaints, status reports and dismissal or closing papers separate the two live cases from settled and dismissed ones; the answer counts two with exclusions. Runs differ only in how many scan reruns and agent-declared steps (per-matter index, ranking, background scan, candidate snippet extraction) they took. Reviews kept flagging unopened surfaced matters and a stale status report for one counted case; none of this changed the count.
